llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed retirement-simulation workflow that sends approved financial inputs to Vestafolio and shows no hidden install, persistence, or credential behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses network access to GET a schema and POST financial simulation fields to vestafolio.com; this is sensitive personal financial data, but the destination and consent step are clearly disclosed and scoped.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, hooks, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It requires asking for missing inputs, disclosing the external API destination, summarizing data to be sent, obtaining user agreement, and omitting unrelated sensitive data such as credentials, files, account identifiers, and conversation history.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, credential use, local profile/session access, background worker, or memory-writing behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to calculate French early-retirement/FIRE scenarios using Vestafolio's simulator API, and its requested capabilities match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that using the skill means the agent may send your savings, income, expenses, mortgage, age, and retirement assumptions to Vestafolio after asking for your agreement. Review the summarized fields before approving the API call, and treat results as estimates rather than financial advice.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: The external POST to https://www.vestafolio.com/api/tools/v1/age-retraite is real, but it is the core simulator workflow and is paired with explicit user-consent and data-minimization instructions.
[SQP-3] expected: Replying in French when the user writes in French is a locale-response behavior aligned with a French retirement simulator and does not create a security concern in this artifact.
